subject: Admin activity evidence: handoff options, encryption, and sampling
messages:
From: SOC2-Audit@brightcompliance.com <SOC2-Audit@brightcompliance.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@omnihealth.org
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: admin activity exports and provenance for OmniHealth SOC 2

Hi Ben,

We're kicking off the evidence collection for OmniHealth's SOC 2 Type II assessment and need an inventory and delivery plan for admin activity / operator logs. Specifically we need:

- A short summary of what events Redwood records (admin login, role changes, API key management, model deploy/rollback, instance lifecycle, delegation/grants, and policy changes).
- Retention windows for each event class and any per-tenant retention overrides.
- Export options: on-demand snapshot (CSV/NDJSON), streaming feed (Kafka/S3), and signed archive (HMAC + manifest).
- Encryption-at-rest and in-transit details for exported bundles.
- Sampling guidance if full historic exports are >60GB.

Can you confirm you can deliver a sample export (30 days) and an HMAC-signed manifest? Also list any PII redaction options. Attachment: we will accept an example schema mapping if you have one.

Thanks,
Maya R. (BrightCompliance)
SOC 2 Engagement Lead

[Attachment: request_checklist.docx (docx)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: SOC2-Audit@brightcompliance.com <SOC2-Audit@brightcompliance.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, compliance@omnihealth.org
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity exports and provenance for OmniHealth SOC 2

Maya —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you requested. Quick overview and proposed options (we can follow whichever path OmniHealth prefers):

1) What we log
- Admin auth events (SSO/SAML, MFA successes/failures)
- Privileged session starts/stops
- Role and permission changes (who changed what, before/after)
- API key creation/rotation/deletion
- Model deploys / rollbacks / version pinning events
- Instance host lifecycle (start/stop/terminate) and GPU allocation traces
- Console actions (policy updates, billing account link/unlink)

2) Retention
- Default: 365 days for high-sensitivity admin events; 730 days for system-level audit traces (config + deploys).
- Enterprise customers can request extended retention (contract addendum); shorter retention can be applied for test tenants.

3) Export formats and provenance
- On-demand CSV/NDJSON snapshot (we include event-level timestamp, actor_id, actor_email, tenant_id, region, event_type, event_meta).
- S3-delivered archive with ZIP (AES-256), plus an HMAC-SHA256 signed manifest.
- For streaming, we can provide an S3-ready batch dump or a Kafka export (topic per-tenant) via secure peering.

4) Encryption and signing
- Exports are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).
- We produce HMAC-SHA256 manifests signed with a customer-shared secret or deliver via a signed envelope (PKI) when requested.

5) Sampling & size control
- If the full export is very large we suggest: time-window chunking (7-14 day slices) + deterministic sampling (every Nth event within a time bucket) and an accompanying sample manifest indicating sampling seed so samples are reproducible.

6) PII redaction
- Configurable redaction presets: none | mask (email/username hashed) | strip (remove sensitive fields). We can also deliver a masked+raw split under NDA.

Next steps: if OmniHealth confirms S3 bucket endpoint + preferred signing method (HMAC key or PKI), we can produce a 30-day sample in 48 hours. I've attached the event schema and an export-options matrix for clarity.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
(Attachment: redwood_admin_event_schema_v2.csv)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, SOC2-Audit@brightcompliance.com <SOC2-Audit@brightcompliance.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, compliance@omnihealth.org
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity exports and provenance for OmniHealth SOC 2

Ben + Maya —

Adding a few implementation-level notes from the Security team to make sure the sample is audit-ready: 

- Atomicity and ordering: exports include event sequence numbers and monotonic timestamps (RFC3339). We attach a low-latency snapshot ID to each file so you can prove completeness across slices.
- Evidence attestation: we recommend HMAC + detached manifest and an optional signing by our Compliance team (PDF signature) for formal handoff.
- Hashing of exported files: we include SHA256 checksums in the manifest; checksums are computed before encryption so auditors can validate archive integrity.
- Access audit trail: we will provide a short operator-access ledger showing who requested exports and when (helps with chain-of-custody).
- Sampling disclosure: if sampling is used we will include the sampling algorithm, seed, and an explanation of expected coverage per event-type.
- Redaction log: any PII redactions will be logged and a redaction-justification field will be present in the manifest.

For OmniHealth we should also verify whether the auditor requires signed timestamps (RFC 3161) on the manifest — we can support a timestamp authority (TSA) if requested.

I'll coordinate with Infra (Karthik) to confirm export throughput and whether any on-prem peering SLA is needed for a Kafka stream.

— Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: export_options_matrix.xlsx)

From: SOC2-Audit@brightcompliance.com <SOC2-Audit@brightcompliance.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, compliance@omnihealth.org
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:43:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity exports and provenance for OmniHealth SOC 2

Thanks Ben and Laura — this covers everything we need to start. A few follow-ups: 

1) Please proceed with the 30-day sample (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30). Deliver to the OmniHealth S3 staging bucket (s3://omnihealth-soc2-staging) with an HMAC manifest. We'll provide the HMAC key via the secure channel.

2) Please include the operator-access ledger as a separate file and the SHA256 checksums in the manifest.

3) OmniHealth prefers "mask" redaction for email addresses in the export; include the redaction log.

4) Timeline: can you confirm ETA for the sample and let us know if you need a DocuSign for the handoff/NDAs? We need artifacts before 2026-11-22 for our pre-audit.

On the quoting side, please include any transfer/storage cost estimates for a 90-day full export if we decide to request it. 

Appreciate the quick turnaround — forwarding this to OmniHealth compliance so they have the plan.

— Maya R.
